_comment: What the viewer can and cannot do, as of the date below. content-gen puts this in every prompt and rejects drafts that promise anything from `cannot` (patterns are checked case-insensitively on each sentence that does not also contain a negation). Update it in the same commit as the feature.
can: Open DWG and DXF files in the browser, with the file read locally by GNU LibreDWG compiled to WebAssembly; nothing is uploaded
Works in current Chrome, Safari, Firefox and Edge on Windows, macOS, Linux, iPhone, iPad and Android; no install, no account
Pan by dragging or with two fingers, zoom with the wheel or a pinch, fit the drawing to the screen
Turn layers on and off; turning on a frozen layer thaws it
Measure: click points to get length, dx/dy, angle, a running total and the area of a closed outline; snaps to endpoints, midpoints, crossings and the nearest point on a line
The drawing unit is read from the file header and can be changed, because the header is often wrong

Export to vector PDF: the whole drawing, the current view or a picked window; sheets A4 to A0 and Letter; auto, portrait or landscape; fit to sheet or a fixed scale from 1:1 to 1:1000; colours or black and white; three line widths; preview before download
Text is drawn with an open font (osifont), so it can look slightly different from AutoCAD
Open source under GPL-3.0, code on GitHub; anyone can host their own copy
cannot: Export or save to DXF or DWG, or convert between DWG versions
Export to JPG, PNG, SVG or other image formats
Show 3D models in 3D or render them
Open RVT, IFC, STEP, SKP, PDF or other non-DWG/DXF formats
Resolve external references (xrefs) or load missing SHX fonts
Work fully offline before the page has been loaded once
